title: Find the names of cards illustrated by artists who have also created cards
question: Find the names of cards illustrated by artists who have also created cards in the 'Coldsnap' set, where those cards are legal in the 'pauper' format, available in 'paper', and have an EDHRec rank below 100. Return only the top 5 such cards by converted mana cost (highest first).

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_049"
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1."XCL_072" = T2."XCL_086"
WHERE T2."XCL_084" = 'pauper'
  AND T1."XCL_004" = 'paper'
  AND T1."XCL_014" < 100
  AND T1."XCL_002" IN (
    SELECT T3."XCL_002"
    FROM cards AS T3
    INNER JOIN sets AS T4 ON T3."XCL_063" = T4."XCL_099"
    WHERE T4."XCL_110" = 'Coldsnap'
  )
ORDER BY T1."XCL_011" DESC
LIMIT 5
